description: Fetch ONE series with every dimension named by you (no guessing or relaxing): dataset, ISO3 countries, an ISO period range and a member code for every dimension from get_structure. Returns status ok/empty/refused with each value's provenance, and the missing country-periods listed. A bad request is a named 400 error saying which field and what is allowed.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (e.g. "JPN") or an aggregate code listed in the dataset's /structure. 1 to 25 entries.

dataset.description: A dataset id from the catalog, as returned by search (/v1/search, or the search_datasets MCP tool), e.g. "ilo-sdmx:DF_X".

period.description: Inclusive ISO period range. "latest" is not accepted: name the periods you want. Annual 2020, quarterly 2020-Q1, monthly 2020-01.

end.description: Last period, same form and frequency as start.

start.description: First period, ISO form: YYYY, YYYY-Qn or YYYY-MM. Must match a frequency the dataset serves.

select.description: A member code for every dimension of the dataset (other than geography and time) as listed in /structure, including frequency. Every dimension must be named; a missing or unknown dimension or code is a 400, never defaulted.

name: get_series
